answer: Hardware is the one ledger a sybil cannot fork. Seal inside each device a physical unclonable function: challenge it and electrons scramble across a random ridge of silicon, returning a pattern as singular and unrepeatable as footprints drifting down a dune. Every vertex in the trust graph then anchors to one manufactured part, not one throwaway script. Cloning votes now means building, shipping and quality-testing thousands of real machines — factory lead time, not a private key, becomes the attacker's ceiling.
